headline: Khaitan & Co advises as BKT Tyres wheels in Pirelli to India
sum: Balkrishna Industries Limited (BKT Tyres) has entered into a strategic agreement with Pirelli to capture opportunities in the Indian car tyre market. Khaitan & Co advised BKT Tyres on this transaction.
detail: Balkrishna Industries Limited (BKT Tyres) has entered into a strategic agreement with Pirelli to capture opportunities in the Indian car tyre market. Khaitan & Co advised BKT Tyres on this transaction. The core team consisted of Purti Minawala (Partner), Ayush Sinha (Principal Associate), Abhijeet Kamath (Principal Associate), Associates Shanay Patrawala and Manvi Talwar.
